# Persona Generator

> Experimental discovery file for a protocol-first Markdown framework that generates academically bounded fictional personas on demand for multi-agent rehearsal.

`llms.txt` is not an official GitHub standard, and crawler or model support is not guaranteed. Read only the smallest task-specific path. Do not crawl the entire repository by default.

## Public Example

- [Limited public beta fixture](https://github.com/focaxisdev/persona-generator/blob/main/examples/limited-public-beta/README.md)

Examples are fictional fixtures for format and safety demonstration only. They are not runtime inventory, datasets, or reusable persona catalog entries.

## Do Not Use For

Real-person profiling, diagnosis, psychometric scoring, sensitive-attribute inference, hiring, surveillance, legal, medical, credit, insurance, educational placement, or autonomous decisions.
